entries.summaryZh: 507年春，法兰克国王克洛维一世率军在普瓦捷附近的武耶击败西哥特国王阿拉里克二世，阿拉里克阵亡。西哥特人退出高卢大部，法兰克人夺取阿基坦，克洛维随后定都巴黎。此役使法兰克王国成为西欧最强势力，也被后世视为法国王权叙事的起点之一。
entries.summaryEn: In the spring of 507 Clovis, king of the Franks, defeated the Visigothic army of Alaric II at Vouille near Poitiers; Alaric was killed and the Visigoths lost most of their Gallic territory. The victory gave the Franks Aquitania and made Clovis the strongest ruler in western Europe.
entries.significanceZh: 武耶之战使法兰克人取代西哥特人成为高卢的主导力量，奠定了法兰克王国在西欧的霸权。
entries.significanceEn: Vouille replaced Visigothic with Frankish dominance in Gaul and laid the foundation of the Frankish kingdom's supremacy in western Europe.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基百科尚无武耶之战条目，只有其所属战争的条目；本条来源为英文维基与维基数据实体，维基数据P585记为507年。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no article on the battle itself, only on the war it belongs to; the entry cites English Wikipedia and the Wikidata entity, whose P585 records 507.

entries.summaryZh: 1945年4月，日本大本营为抵御盟军进攻冲绳实施天号作战，以海军航空兵的多轮菊水特攻配合以战列舰大和号为核心的海上特攻舰队出击。大和号等六艘日舰在驶往冲绳途中被美军舰载机击沉，航空特攻也未能阻止盟军。此役是日本海军联合舰队的最后一场大规模行动。
entries.summaryEn: In April 1945 the Japanese high command carried out Operation Ten-Go to oppose the Allied invasion of Okinawa, combining waves of kamikaze air attacks with a surface force built around the battleship Yamato. American carrier aircraft sank Yamato and five other warships before they reached Okinawa, and the air attacks also failed to stop the Allies.
entries.significanceZh: 天号作战是日本海军联合舰队的最后一场大规模行动，标志日本海上主力在太平洋战争中彻底覆灭。
entries.significanceEn: Ten-Go was the last major operation of the Japanese fleet and marked the destruction of its remaining surface strength in the Pacific War.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基的天号作战条目涵盖航空与海上两部分，英文维基对应条目现题为Operation Kikusui I；维基数据P585记为1945年。
entries.notesEn: The Chinese Wikipedia article covers both the air and the surface parts while the English article is now titled Operation Kikusui I; Wikidata P585 records 1945.

entries.summaryZh: 公元前480年夏，希腊城邦联合舰队在优卑亚岛北端的阿提密西安海面与波斯舰队连续交战三天，与温泉关陆战同时进行。希腊舰队在风暴与激战中损失不小，但阻止了波斯海军绕击希腊陆军后方。温泉关失守后，希腊舰队撤往萨拉米斯，为随后的萨拉米斯海战保存了主力。
entries.summaryEn: In the summer of 480 BCE the allied Greek fleet fought the Persian navy for three days off Artemisium on northern Euboea, at the same time as the land battle at Thermopylae. Storms and hard fighting cost both sides ships, but the Greeks prevented the Persians from turning their position; after Thermopylae fell the fleet withdrew to Salamis.
entries.significanceZh: 阿提密西安海战是希腊联军在波斯入侵中的首次海上抵抗，为萨拉米斯海战的胜利保存了舰队主力。
entries.significanceEn: Artemisium was the Greeks' first naval stand against the Persian invasion and preserved the fleet that won at Salamis.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基百科尚无该战役的独立条目；维基数据P585记为ISO -479年，即民用纪年的公元前480年，与英文维基的记载一致。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no separate article on this battle; Wikidata P585 records ISO -479, which is 480 BCE in the civil convention used here, matching the English article.

entries.summaryZh: 1944年4月至6月，日军在英帕尔作战中进攻印度东北那加丘陵的重镇科希马，企图切断英帕尔英印军队的补给公路。英印部队在孤立阵地上坚守，双方围绕山头与公路展开近距离争夺，日军在雨季与补给断绝中被迫撤退。此役与英帕尔战役一同构成日军进攻印度的转折点。
entries.summaryEn: From April to June 1944 Japanese forces attacking Imphal tried to take Kohima in the Naga Hills and cut the road supplying the British and Indian IV Corps. The garrison held a shrinking perimeter in close-quarters fighting until relief arrived, and the Japanese, short of supplies in the monsoon, withdrew. The battle turned back the U-Go offensive.
entries.significanceZh: 科希马战役与英帕尔战役共同构成日军进攻印度的转折点，此后日军再未能威胁印度本土。
entries.significanceEn: Kohima and Imphal together turned back the Japanese offensive into India, after which the Japanese never threatened India again.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基百科尚无科希马战役条目；中英文维基与维基数据均系于1944年，本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no article on the battle; both Wikipedia articles and Wikidata P585 give 1944 and the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 190年，关东诸侯起兵讨伐董卓，董卓部将徐荣在荥阳汴水一带迎击联军。曹操率部先行西进，在汴水遭徐荣伏击，士卒伤亡惨重，曹操本人中箭受伤，靠曹洪让马才得以脱险。此役使讨董联军初战受挫，各路诸侯此后多持观望，联军事实上瓦解。
entries.summaryEn: In 190, after the eastern warlords rose against Dong Zhuo, his general Xu Rong met the coalition at the Bian River near Xingyang. Cao Cao advanced ahead of the others and was ambushed, losing most of his troops; wounded by arrows, he escaped only because Cao Hong gave him his horse. The defeat broke the coalition's first offensive.
entries.significanceZh: 荥阳之战使讨董联军初战失利并迅速瓦解，为董卓迁都长安与群雄割据的局面铺路。
entries.significanceEn: Xingyang broke the coalition's first offensive and hastened both Dong Zhuo's move to Chang'an and the warlord fragmentation.
entries.notesZh: 荥阳在公元前205年与公元190年都有同名战事，本条专指190年讨董之战；英文维基同名页为消歧义页。
entries.notesEn: Xingyang saw battles in 205 BCE and 190 CE; this entry is the 190 action against Dong Zhuo and the English title is a disambiguation page.

entries.titleZh: 阿莱格里亚德皮奥战役
entries.summaryZh: 1956年12月5日，菲德尔·卡斯特罗等82名七二六运动成员乘格拉玛号游艇在古巴南部登陆三天后，在阿莱格里亚德皮奥遭古巴政府军突袭。起义队伍被打散，伤亡严重，幸存者分散逃入马埃斯特腊山区。此役是古巴革命中起义军与政府军的首次交锋，队伍经数月才重新集结。
entries.summaryEn: On 5 December 1956, three days after Fidel Castro and 82 members of the 26th of July Movement landed from the yacht Granma on Cuba's southern coast, the Cuban army surprised them at Alegria de Pio. The rebels were scattered with heavy casualties and the survivors fled into the Sierra Maestra; it was the first clash of the revolution.
entries.significanceZh: 阿莱格里亚德皮奥之战是古巴革命的第一场战斗，起义军虽遭重创，但幸存者进入山区转入游击战。
entries.significanceEn: Alegria de Pio was the first battle of the Cuban Revolution; mauled but surviving, the rebels turned to guerrilla warfare in the mountains.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基均系于1956年12月5日；本条只保留年份精度，不折算月日。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles date the battle to 5 December 1956; the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1066年9月20日，挪威国王哈拉尔三世与托斯蒂格率维京军队在约克以南的富尔福德击败英格兰北部伯爵埃德温和莫卡。此役是1066年王位争夺战的开端，五天后哈拉尔在斯坦福桥之战中阵亡，英军随即南下迎击诺曼底公爵威廉，并在黑斯廷斯战败。
entries.summaryEn: On 20 September 1066 a Viking army under King Harald Hardrada of Norway and Tostig Godwinson defeated the northern earls Edwin and Morcar at Fulford outside York. It was the opening battle of the 1066 succession crisis; five days later Harald was killed at Stamford Bridge and the English army marched south to face William of Normandy.
entries.significanceZh: 富尔福德战役拉开了1066年三场决战的序幕，其消耗直接影响了英格兰在黑斯廷斯的败局。
entries.significanceEn: Fulford opened the three-battle crisis of 1066 and the losses it cost England contributed to the defeat at Hastings.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基百科尚无富尔福德战役条目；中英文维基与维基数据均系于1066年，本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no article on the battle; both Wikipedia articles and Wikidata P585 give 1066 and the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 981年，北宋以前朝内乱为由出兵交趾，前黎朝皇帝黎桓在白藤江一带迎战。黎桓先诈降诱敌深入，再以水军截击，宋军在支棱与白藤江受挫，水路运输被切断，被迫撤军。此役使越南在前黎朝治下保持了独立，是宋越之间第一次大规模战争的决定性战役。
entries.summaryEn: In 981 the Song dynasty invaded the Vietnamese kingdom of Dai Co Viet and the Le emperor Le Hoan met the invaders at the Bach Dang river. Feigning surrender to draw the Song fleet forward, he cut the river with stakes and ambushed it; the Song forces, their supply route broken, withdrew, securing Vietnamese independence under the Early Le.
entries.significanceZh: 981年白藤江之战使越南在前黎朝治下保持独立，是宋越之间第一次大规模战争的决定性战役。
entries.significanceEn: Bach Dang in 981 preserved Vietnamese independence under the Early Le and decided the first large-scale war between Song China and Vietnam.
entries.notesZh: 英文维基的同名条目涵盖938、981与1288年三次白藤江之战，本条引用其中981年部分；中文维基条目为981年宋越战争。
entries.notesEn: The English article of this name covers the three battles of Bach Dang in 938, 981 and 1288; this entry cites the 981 section, and the Chinese article covers the Song-Viet war of 981.

entries.summaryZh: 15世纪后期，印加帝国军队向南扩张至现今智利中部马乌莱河一带，与马普切人联军激战三日，最终未能继续南进。传统说法把此役系于图帕克·印加·尤潘基在位期间，即1471至1493年，也有学者认为年代要晚得多。马乌莱河因此长期被视为印加帝国扩张的南界。
entries.summaryEn: In the later fifteenth century an Inca army advancing into what is now central Chile fought a Mapuche coalition for three days at the Maule River and failed to advance further. The battle is traditionally placed in the reign of Tupac Inca Yupanqui (1471-93), though some historians date it much later.
entries.significanceZh: 马乌莱河战役通常被视为印加帝国向南扩张的终点，塑造了安第斯文明与马普切世界的分界。
entries.significanceEn: The Maule is conventionally treated as the southern limit of Inca expansion and the boundary between Andean and Mapuche worlds.
entries.notesZh: 战役年代与是否具有决定性均有争议：传统系于1471至1493年间，另有学者主张晚至1532年；本条采用维基数据P585的1471年并保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Both the date and the decisiveness of the battle are disputed: tradition places it between 1471 and 1493 while one historian argues for 1532; the entry follows the Wikidata P585 year of 1471.

entries.summaryZh: 1947年3月16日，二二八事件期间，国民党军队在台湾南投埔里的乌牛栏（今爱兰里）与当地民众武装交战。民众一方据桥头与河岸抵抗，终因武器与训练差距被击退。此役是二二八事件中民众武装在中部地区规模较大的一次抵抗，也标志着事件在埔里一带的平息。
entries.summaryEn: On 16 March 1947, during the 228 Incident in Taiwan, Nationalist troops fought a local militia at O-gu-lan, today's Ailan village, in Puli, Nantou County. The defenders held the bridge and riverbank before being driven back by troops with better arms and training. It was one of the larger armed resistances in central Taiwan during the incident.
entries.significanceZh: 乌牛栏之役是二二八事件中中部民众武装较大规模的抵抗，反映了事件期间地方自卫力量的短暂集结。
entries.significanceEn: O-gu-lan was one of the larger armed resistances in central Taiwan during the 228 Incident and shows how briefly local defence forces mobilised.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基记1947年3月16日；英文维基百科尚无该条目，本条来源为中文维基与维基数据实体。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia dates the fighting to 16 March 1947; English Wikipedia has no article on it and the entry cites the Chinese article and the Wikidata entity.

entries.summaryZh: 1949年8月，第二次国共内战衡宝战役前夕，中国人民解放军第四野战军在湖南双峰青树坪追击国民党桂系部队，遭对方反击而受挫。此役是三大战役之后解放军少有的失利，被国民党方面称为永丰大捷。青树坪之战促使四野调整战术，随后在衡宝战役中歼灭桂系主力。
entries.summaryEn: In August 1949, on the eve of the Hengbao campaign of the Chinese Civil War, the Fourth Field Army of the People's Liberation Army pursued Guangxi clique forces at Qingshuping in Hunan and was counter-attacked and checked. It was one of the few PLA defeats after the three great campaigns and was celebrated by the Nationalists as the Yongfeng victory.
entries.significanceZh: 青树坪战役是解放军在三大战役后少有的失利，促使第四野战军调整战法并在衡宝战役中歼灭桂系主力。
entries.significanceEn: Qingshuping was a rare PLA defeat after the three great campaigns and pushed the Fourth Field Army to adjust before destroying the Guangxi clique at Hengbao.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基记1949年8月；英文维基百科尚无该条目，本条来源为中文维基与维基数据实体，维基数据P585记为1949年。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia dates the battle to August 1949; English Wikipedia has no article and the entry cites the Chinese article and the Wikidata entity, whose P585 records 1949.

entries.summaryZh: 1081年10月，诺曼人首领罗贝尔·吉斯卡尔率军进攻拜占庭帝国的都拉斯，即今阿尔巴尼亚都拉斯。拜占庭皇帝阿莱克修斯一世亲率大军迎战，诺曼重骑兵击破拜占庭阵线，皇帝本人受伤脱险。此役打开了诺曼人入侵巴尔干的门户，也迫使拜占庭向威尼斯求援。
entries.summaryEn: In October 1081 Robert Guiscard's Normans besieged Dyrrhachium, the Byzantine bridgehead on the Adriatic, and Emperor Alexios I marched to relieve it. The Norman heavy cavalry broke the Byzantine line and the emperor was wounded in the fighting; the defeat opened the Balkans to the Normans and pushed Byzantium into alliance with Venice.
entries.significanceZh: 都拉斯战役打开了诺曼人入侵巴尔干的道路，是阿莱克修斯一世即位初期最严重的军事挫败。
entries.significanceEn: Dyrrhachium opened the Norman invasion of the Balkans and was the worst military defeat of Alexios I's early reign.
entries.notesZh: 都拉斯在公元前48年、1018年与1081年都有同名战事，本条专指1081年诺曼与拜占庭之战；中文维基百科尚无该条。
entries.notesEn: Dyrrhachium saw battles in 48 BCE, 1018 and 1081; this entry is the 1081 Norman-Byzantine battle and Chinese Wikipedia has no article on it.

entries.summaryZh: 公元前478年，越王勾践趁吴国饥荒出兵攻吴，在笠泽（今江苏吴江一带）与吴军夹江对峙。越军以两翼佯攻、主力中央夜渡的战术突破吴军防线，吴军大败。此役是越灭吴战争中的决定性一战，吴国自此一蹶不振，数年后被越所灭，勾践成为春秋最后一位霸主。
entries.summaryEn: In 478 BCE King Goujian of Yue attacked Wu during a famine and faced its army across the river at Lize. Feigning attacks on both wings while his main force crossed at night, he broke the Wu line. Wu never recovered and was destroyed a few years later, making Goujian the last hegemon of the Spring and Autumn.
entries.significanceZh: 笠泽之战是越灭吴的决定性战役，吴国由此丧失抵抗能力，勾践随后称霸。
entries.significanceEn: Lize was the decisive battle in Yue's destruction of Wu, after which Goujian became hegemon.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基的条目为战争条目越灭吴之战，笠泽之战见其中；英文维基单列该战役并系于公元前478年，与维基数据P585的ISO -477年（民用纪年前478年）一致。
entries.notesEn: The Chinese article covers the whole Yue-Wu war with the battle inside it, while English Wikipedia has a separate article dating it to 478 BCE, matching Wikidata P585 ISO -477 in the civil convention used here.

entries.summaryZh: 公元前205年4月，楚汉战争期间，刘邦乘项羽北上攻齐之机，率五诸侯联军攻占楚都彭城。项羽闻讯后率三万精兵回师，清晨自萧县侧击联军，半日之内将数十万汉军击溃，睢水为之不流。刘邦仅以身免，其父与妻被楚军俘获，诸侯纷纷背汉归楚。
entries.summaryEn: In April 205 BCE Liu Bang took the Chu capital Pengcheng with a large coalition while Xiang Yu was campaigning in Qi. Xiang Yu returned with thirty thousand picked troops, fell on the allied camp at dawn and routed the far larger Han army in half a day; Liu Bang escaped alone and several allies defected to Chu.
entries.significanceZh: 彭城之战是中国古代以少胜多的著名战例，楚汉战争的战略主动权一度重回项羽之手。
entries.significanceEn: Pengcheng is a famous Chinese victory against overwhelming odds and briefly returned the strategic initiative to Xiang Yu.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基与维基数据均系于公元前205年；维基数据P585记为ISO -204年，本项目民用纪年无0年，本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles and Wikidata give 205 BCE; P585 records ISO -204 because the civil convention used here has no year zero, and the entry keeps year precision.
